findings.finding:
The original heading "Choose what you want to work on" exactly matches the source heading

Choose what you want to work on

. The proposed change, "Select a skill or topic to develop," narrows and reframes the invitation. The source deliberately uses open language ('what you want to work on'), which can refer to any focus, not limited to skills or topics. Changing this heading constrains the intent and does not hold to the instruction to preserve record material exactly.

The proposed refinement to field1 closely tracks the substance of the source. It adds clarity by clearly stating both that the choice is not saved and that there is no personal profile, which the source also implies. The meaning does not change and matches the privacy assurance ('not saved as a personal profile'). This is reasonable for increased clarity.
